title: 투모로우 워
ctx: Film 「The Tomorrow War」(2021, Amazon Prime Video original, director Chris McKay). Chris Pratt as Dan Forester, a former Green Beret turned high-school biology teacher; Yvonne Strahovski as Romeo Command (Muri Forester, Dan's grown-up daughter from 2051); Ryan Kiera Armstrong as young Muri; J. K. Simmons as James Forester, Dan's estranged father; Betty Gilpin as Emmy, Dan's wife; Sam Richardson as Charlie, a nervous scientist draftee; Edwin Hodge as Dorian, a veteran on his third tour; Mary Lynn Rajskub as Norah. Soldiers from 2051 arrive during the 2022 World Cup to say humanity is losing a war against alien 'Whitespikes'; civilians are drafted and jumped 30 years into the future for 7-day tours. Dan finds his daughter, she develops a toxin from a captured female alien, the future base falls, Dan returns to 2022, finds the alien ship buried in Russian ice, and with his father and Charlie destroys the aliens before they wake.
